schema.title: Admin token digest settings
schema.description: The lifecycle settings document is the SHA-256 digest as a JSON string, not an object. Unicode whitespace around the digest is ignored; the digest of an empty token is refused. Configure a digest, never the token.

schema.title: GitHub login settings
schema.description: The lifecycle configuration parsed as GitHubConfig. client_secret is resolved by the host via the Statement secret_refs and lent separately, never accepted in this settings object. Lifecycle validation also checks normalized URL hosts and the plaintext transport policy.

client_id.description: OAuth client id; an empty string is refused.

scopes.description: With fetch_orgs enabled, must include read:org, write:org, admin:org or user.

api_base.description: Must be written explicitly so its host enters the hop allowlist. HTTP is permitted only for a private or loopback host.

authorize_base.description: HTTP(S) URL with a host; authorize redirects also permit public HTTP.

token_base.description: Must be written explicitly so its host enters the hop allowlist. HTTP is permitted only for a private or loopback host.

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional additional CA certificate PEM; lifecycle requires the BEGIN CERTIFICATE marker.

schema.title: Header auth lifecycle settings
schema.description: A closed bag of keys shared by the outbound styles. Values and style-specific defaults are checked at open_outbound, not lifecycle validate; no style is selected by this document. Credentials are lent separately. An absent settings blob is equivalent to {}.

header.description: Custom header name, checked when the selected style is bound. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

families.description: Credential-family presentations, checked at binding. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

own.description: Own-credential presentation, checked at binding. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

passthrough.description: Caller-credential presentation, checked at binding. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

protocol.description: Protocol label, checked at binding. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

param.description: Query parameter name, checked at binding. Lifecycle validation accepts any JSON value for this known key.

token_url.description: Forwarded provider setting; ignored by this plugin, including its value.

token_uri.description: Forwarded provider setting; ignored by this plugin, including its value.

scope.description: Forwarded provider setting; ignored by this plugin, including its value.

subject.description: Forwarded provider setting; ignored by this plugin, including its value.

schema.title: LDAP login settings
schema.description: Lifecycle settings parsed as LdapConfig. The host removes and resolves the bind_service_password reference before validation and lends the secret separately at open. Lifecycle validation additionally parses the LDAP URL, enforces the plaintext transport policy, parses the RFC 4515 filter and checks certificate DER framing.

url.description: An ldap:// or ldaps:// endpoint accepted by the dialer. Plaintext to non-loopback requires start_tls or allow_insecure_transport.

bind_dn_template.description: Contains {username}; direct-bind additionally requires = so it names a DN.

user_search_filter.description: Optional RFC 4515 filter with {username} in an assertion value. Enables search-then-bind.

bind_service_dn.description: Required and non-blank with a user_search_filter.

bind_service_password.description: Only absent or null reaches lifecycle settings. A literal password is refused; configure the Statement secret reference for host resolution. A non-empty resolved password is required at open in search-then-bind mode.

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional additional CA PEM. Every CERTIFICATE block must decode to DER beginning with a SEQUENCE byte, and at least one block is required.

schema.title: OAuth lifecycle settings
schema.description: Union of the jwt-bearer, oauth-client-credentials and oauth-token-exchange settings. Lifecycle validation does not require an endpoint or a selected style; binding does. Credentials are lent separately. An absent blob is equivalent to {}.

token_url.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

token_uri.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

scope.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

subject.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

resource.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

subject_token_type.description: Optional non-blank setting; null is treated as absent. Binding applies style-specific requirements.

max_response_bytes.description: Token response byte limit; null also selects the default.

schema.title: OIDC settings
schema.description: Lifecycle settings parsed as OidcConfig. client_secret is a host-resolved Statement secret reference, lent separately and never accepted here. Lifecycle also parses configured URLs and enforces HTTPS, with the documented local/private HTTP exceptions.

issuer.description: Exact issuer URL. HTTPS, or HTTP to loopback; no query, fragment or control characters.

jwks_url.description: Optional JWKS URL; otherwise discovered from issuer. HTTPS, or HTTP to loopback (accepted with a warning; fetching still requires HTTPS).

ca_cert_pem.description: Optional additional CA PEM, lent to the host connector as trust_from. Lifecycle checks only that the supplied string is non-blank.

client_id.description: Defaults to audience when absent or null.

scopes.description: Additional scopes; openid is always added and duplicates are removed when building the authorize URL.

authorization_endpoint.description: Optional authorize URL, discovered when absent. HTTPS or loopback HTTP; no fragment or control characters.

token_endpoint.description: Optional token URL, discovered when absent. HTTPS or private/loopback HTTP; no control characters.

schema.title: SigV4 lifecycle settings
schema.description: Instance-level settings, before an outbound signing binding is selected. Credentials are lent separately. An absent blob is equivalent to {}.

service.description: Optional at lifecycle validation; signing bindings require a non-null value. Surrounding Unicode whitespace is trimmed.

region.description: Optional at lifecycle validation; signing bindings require a non-null value. Surrounding Unicode whitespace is trimmed.

region_unread.description: Host warning about region resolution. Lifecycle accepts any value; the signing binding checks string or null.

content_type.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

token_url.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

token_uri.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

scope.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

subject.description: Compatibility/provider setting ignored by this plugin; any JSON value is accepted.

schema.title: Webhook signature settings
schema.description: Lifecycle settings parsed as Settings. signing_secret (and its signing-secret alias) are resolved via the Statement secret_refs and lent separately, never accepted in this object.

origin.description: Twilio sender scheme://authority, without path, query, fragment, ASCII whitespace or controls. A bracketed host must be non-empty; an explicit port must be non-empty decimal digits.

tolerance_secs.description: Standard Webhooks only; null/absent selects 300 seconds. Zero is accepted.

subject.description: Defaults to webhook-signature:<variant> when absent or null. An empty string is refused; whitespace is retained.

path.description: JSONL destination path, required, nonempty and without NUL characters.

rotate_mb.description: Rotate at this size in MiB; absent or null never rotates. Zero rotates before every append.

keep.description: Archives retained by the host; absent or null uses 9, zero truncates in place.

url.description: Required OTLP/HTTP collector URL, literal or env/file/module reference resolved by the host. Ambiguous credential-bearing URLs are refused by validate/open; URL and destination admission belong to the host.

buffer_seconds.description: Retention window of the rolling quantile summary, in seconds.

key_gauge_limit.description: Maximum per-key gauge series emitted by the host on each scrape.

url.description: The HTTPS webhook target, as a literal URL or an env/file/module reference resolved by the host. Ambiguous credential-bearing URLs are refused by validate/open; the host enforces HTTPS and public-destination policy.

auth_header.description: Optional auth header. Null omits it; the legacy [name, value] string pair remains accepted. The name must be an HTTP token other than a framing/connection field, and the value must be a valid HTTP header value; validate/open enforce these checks.

value.description: The complete credential header value, preferably provided by an env/file/module reference such as {"env":"WEBHOOK_AUTHORIZATION"}. The export host also preserves existing literal values.

max_inflight_deliveries.description: Max concurrent deliveries. Zero is accepted for an instance beside a sibling with a positive bound; check requires the largest bound across instances to be at least one.

expected_units.description: Per-class finite, non-negative expected-unit overrides; an empty map uses plane defaults.

schema.description: Lifecycle settings. Unrecognized keys are accepted with a warning. Configure pushes merge independently optional keys over the live settings. URL syntax, credential ambiguity and egress policy are additionally validated by the plugin at runtime.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL to POST hook envelopes to. HTTPS is required except for loopback HTTP sidecars; private, link-local, metadata and ambiguous credential URLs are refused by runtime validation. References are resolved by the host before lifecycle validation.

timeout_ms.description: Per-op timeout in milliseconds. Missing or null uses 5000 at open; supplied unsigned integer tokens are accepted and clamped to [1, 5000]. In configure pushes, missing or null retains the live value.

schema.title: a2a plane lifecycle settings

pools.description: Host-injected pools: the reader extracts pool.members entries that are strings or objects with a string name. Missing or malformed pools/members are ignored, preserving its tolerant grammar.

url.description: Lifecycle verifies URL syntax and refuses userinfo.

protocol_version.description: Accepted and ignored; discovery reads the card version.

owned_sections.description: PlaneOpenIn.owned / PlaneRefreshIn.owned, separate from the settings argument described by the schema root.

ca.description: Public CA certificate PEM; not a secret.

authored_section.description: Plane-owned raw agents section grammar; host-injected pools are not writable registration input. Core security/source policy, reserved-name checks, SecretRef resolution and module validation still apply.

agents.description: Null/absent is an unconfigured host section; the host does not pass null as a lifecycle settings object.

ca.description: Public CA certificate PEM; not a secret.

user_configuration.description: The supported plane-owned blocks within a complete deploy document. This is not a complete host boot schema.

schema.description: Lifecycle agents settings (bare section, or validate envelope). URL validity, TLS compatibility and registration rules are also checked by validate_agent.

reasoning.description: Boolean overrides the model; any other value is ignored.

context_max.description: Unsigned machine-sized integer overrides context; any other value is ignored.

affinity.description: A string affinity.header_name sets affinity; other shapes are ignored. Credential header names are refused.

anyOf.description: The legacy reader treats non-object JSON as absent sections.

api_key.description: Host-owned provider setting; this plane passes it through without interpreting its value.

base_url.description: Host-owned provider setting; this plane passes it through without interpreting its value.

health.description: Host-owned provider setting; this plane passes it through without interpreting its value.

tool_choice.description: Opaque provider tool-choice JSON, retained verbatim.

section.description: The lifecycle additionally requires max_output_tokens < context_window_tokens; JSON Schema cannot compare sibling numeric values.

values.description: Names and secret strings must each decode to 1–1024 UTF-8 bytes. Empty maps are accepted. Limits count bytes, not Unicode characters.

schema.description: Required instance settings. The encoded JSON document is limited to 8192 bytes and nesting depth 32. Duplicate keys are refused. UTF-8 byte bounds and duplicate-key checks are additionally enforced by the lifecycle parser.
No instance settings. Omit settings or supply an empty object; null and other JSON values are refused. Reference settings are supplied separately to check/resolve.
No instance settings. Omit settings or supply an empty object; null and other JSON values are refused. Reference settings are supplied separately to check/resolve.

addr.description: HTTP(S) Vault server URL with a host, no query or fragment. The lifecycle parser additionally validates URL syntax. URL syntax and supported schemes are checked by the lifecycle parser after this structural schema.

token.description: Required token reference, supplied as any JSON value to validate; open separately requires non-empty resolved token bytes without forbidden HTTP control characters. This describes lifecycle parsing; the host validates secret-reference syntax and resolves material separately.

ca_cert_pem.description: Additional CA certificates, or null. When a string, the lifecycle parser requires at least one well-formed PEM CERTIFICATE with valid base64 and DER sequence length.

timeout_secs.description: HTTP timeout in seconds; the host call deadline still bounds a resolve. Fractional or exponent JSON number spellings are refused.

token.description: Accepted and ignored for compatibility, with any JSON value. Secret references may be supplied here. This describes lifecycle parsing; the host validates secret-reference syntax and resolves material separately.

url.description: MySQL connection URL. The lifecycle parser validates all connection options and refuses unsupported options. Credentials in userinfo are captured as secrets. URL syntax and supported schemes are checked by the lifecycle parser after this structural schema.

A non-blank libpq connection string: postgres:// or postgresql:// URI, or keyword/value form. Requires an explicit non-empty user; connections use TCP rather than Unix sockets. The lifecycle parser validates connection syntax, supported options and SSL mode, and captures the password.

db_path.description: SQLite file or :memory:. Omitted or null uses the default. A string containing only whitespace is refused.

busy_timeout_ms.description: Busy timeout in milliseconds. Omitted or null uses 5000. Fractional or exponent JSON number spellings are refused by the parser.

license_key.description: Accepted and ignored for compatibility, with any JSON value. Secret references may be supplied here. This describes lifecycle parsing; the host validates secret-reference syntax and resolves material separately.

url.description: Valkey/Redis URL, including supported Unix-socket forms. The lifecycle parser validates host, database, protocol, query options and TLS fragment; credentials are captured as secrets. URL syntax and supported schemes are checked by the lifecycle parser after this structural schema.

connect_timeout_ms.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Omitted or null uses 10000. Fractional or exponent JSON number spellings are refused.
